{{External|rs|rsc=Wizard's Tower}} {{Infobox Location |name = Wizards' Tower |image = [[File:Wizards' Tower.png|300px]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |floors = 4 |location = [[Misthalin]] |teleport = {{*}} [[Fairy ring]] {{fairycode|DIS}}
{{*}} East portal of the [[Wizards' Guild]] (requires level 66 Magic)
{{*}} [[Necklace of passage]] |music = [[Vision]] |map = {{Map|name=Wizards' Tower|zoom=3|x=3109|y=3160}} |type = building |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} {{Relativelocation |location = Wizards' Tower |north = Draynor Village |west = Port Sarim |south = Tutorial Island |east = Lumbridge Swamp }} The '''Wizards' Tower''' is located south of [[Draynor Village]], over a bridge. The tower plays a part in many [[quests]]. ==Transportation== *The [[fairy ring]] code {{fairycode|DIS}} teleports you immediately south of the tower. *The [[necklace of passage|necklace of passage]] teleports you to the bridge just north of the tower. *The [[Amulet of the Eye]] teleports the player to the [[Temple of the Eye (location)|Temple of the Eye]], near a portal that takes them to the basement of the guild. *A [[ring of the elements]] can provide a teleport near to the [[Water Altar]] entrance, east of the tower. *An [[Achievement diary cape]] can teleport the player to [[Twiggy O'Korn]] north of the tower *An [[amulet of glory|amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Draynor Village]] to the north of the tower. *Players with 66 [[Magic]] can enter the east portal on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} of the [[Wizards' Guild]]. ==History== The Wizards' Tower was created at the same time as the founding of the [[Order of Wizards]] at the start of the [[Fifth Age]], following the rediscovery of runecrafting.{{CiteNPC|npc=Archmage Sedridor|loc=Rune Mysteries|quote=The rediscovery of runecrafting had such a large impact on the world, that it marked the dawn of the Fifth Age. It also resulted in the birth of our order, and the construction of the first Wizards' Tower.}} Initially, the Order was welcoming of all researching wizards, regardless of their religion or race,{{CiteNPC|npc=Archmage Sedridor|quote=For years, the tower was a hub of magical research. Wizards of all races and religions were welcomed into our order.}} though it has been claimed that Zamorakian wizards were barred from certain research topics.{{CiteNPC|npc=Archmage Sedridor|quote=They banned Zamorakian wizards from certain areas of study, claiming them to be too dangerous. In reality, they [Saradominists] just wanted that knowledge for themselves.}} Sometime one hundred years ago, the Tower was burned down, with decades of research lost, including an incantation that teleports one to the [[rune essence mine]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Archmage Sedridor|loc=Rune Mysteries|quote=When the tower burnt down, much was lost, including an important incantation. A spell that could be used to teleport to a hidden essence mine.}} However, the basement survived its destruction.{{CiteNPC|npc=Archmage Sedridor|quote=This basement is all that is left of the old tower, and I believe there are still some secrets to discover here.}} The Tower's destruction was blamed on the Zamorakian wizards of the Order, who the Order believed to have burnt down the tower in revenge for failing to steal Saradominist research.{{CiteNPC|npc=Archmage Sedridor|quote=The wizards who served Zamorak, the evil god of chaos, tried to claim our magical discoveries in his name. They failed, but in retaliation, they burnt the entire tower to the ground.}} As a result, the Zamorakian wizards were expelled from the Order after the Tower was rebuilt, and they formed the [[Zamorak Magical Institute]].{{CiteNPC|npc=Mage of Zamorak|quote=Naturally, they blamed the Zamorakians. Claimed we intentionally burnt the tower down. After the tower was rebuilt, we were banished from the Order of Wizards and forced underground.}} However, it is claimed that the destruction of the first Tower was the result of a ritual gone wrong,{{CiteNPC|npc=Mage of Zamorak|quote=They used it to perform a ritual, but their lack of understanding caused it to go wrong. The entire Wizards' Tower burnt down. Many were killed, and years of research was destroyed.}} as the Saradominists who performed it stole the research from a Zamorakian wizard, who made the breakthrough in teleportation magic the ritual was based on.{{CiteNPC|npc=Mage of Zamorak|quote=A Zamorakian wizard made a great breakthrough in teleportation magic, but the Saradominists stole his research.}} ==Inside the tower== Inside the tower is a multiple number of floors, and a few notable [[non-player characters]]. The whole tower, except for the basement, is a [[multi-combat zone]]. ===Basement=== The basement is one of two entrances to the [[rune essence]] available to free-players, and one of four for [[members]]. In addition, after the completion of [[Temple of the Eye]], the basement serves as the entrance for [[Guardians of the Rift]] [[minigame]]. The basement also plays a role in [[The Restless Ghost]] [[quest]]. It can be accessed via a ladder on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the Wizards' Tower. The basement is where players can find [[Archmage Sedridor]]. He plays a major role in the [[Rune Mysteries]] quest. He can also [[teleport]] players to the Rune essence mine after completing this quest. There is an altar, but it cannot be used to recharge Prayer points. It is used during the Restless Ghost quest. There is a [[chicken]] in the hallway outside [[Archmage Sedridor]]'s room. ==={{FloorText|uk=0|caps=y|nohelp=y}}=== On the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}, there are two rooms with many [[wizards]]. They are level 9 and quite popular for [[free-to-play]] players as not many monsters drop [[runes]] and these are the only ones that drop [[wizard robes]] (one of the only free-to-play [[magic armour]]s). There is also a [[leather boot]] spawn on the table in the library. At the staircases, there are three log spawns. There are also [[bookcase (Wizards' Tower)|bookcases]] in the library, and players may find the following books while searching them: *The Life & Times of a Thingummywut by [[Traiborn]] the Wizard *[[Wind Strike]] for Beginners *Life With a Wizard Husband ~ a Housewife's Story *The Dark Arts of Magical Wands *So You Think You're a Mage? Volume 28 *Fire, Earth and Water ~ What's it all About? *How to become the Ultimate Wizard of the Universe *101 Ways to Impress Your Mates with Magic === {{FloorText|uk=1|caps=y|nohelp=y}} === On the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} resides the loony [[Traiborn]], and [[Wizard Jalarast]] who can make [[Splitbark armour]] on [[members]]' servers, with the proper supplies. [[Rick (Wizards' Tower)|Rick]], a young student, can also be found here selling elusive [[escape crystal]]s for 10,000 coins. There is one or two level 9 [[wizards]], and also a couple of useless rooms. Traiborn helps you out when making the [[Cake of Guidance]] for the [[Lumbridge Guide]] in the [[quest]], [[Recipe for Disaster]]. === {{FloorText|uk=2|caps=y|nohelp=y}} === On the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} in the tower, there is a caged level 82 [[lesser demon]] free for players to battle with. Because it is caged, it cannot attack any players or do damage to them, but only long-ranged attacks or magic can harm it. If you wish to obtain the drops from the lesser demon, you must use [[Telekinetic Grab]] (33 [[Magic]] required). Also, there is [[Wizard Grayzag]], who '''used''' to be an attackable level 41 [[NPC]], who summoned [[imp]]s to fight against players who attacked him. He plays a role in the [[Imp Catcher]] [[quest]]. After completing the [[Imp Catcher]] [[quest]] the [[Wizard Mizgog]] will exchange an [[amulet of accuracy]] for the four different coloured beads. ==Quests== The following [[quests]] involve traveling to Wizards Tower. {| class="wikitable" !Quest !Connections !Members? |- |[[Imp Catcher]] |Started by speaking to [[Wizard Mizgog]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} and ends with delivering [[Imp#Beads|Beads]] dropped only from imps. |{{Members|No}} |- |[[The Restless Ghost]] |Collect the [[Ghost's skull|skull]] from under the Wizards Tower. |{{Members|No}} |- |[[Demon Slayer]] |Deliver 25 unnoted bones to [[Traiborn]] to get Wizard Traiborn's key. |{{Members|No}} |- |[[Rune Mysteries]] |Deliver [[Air talisman]] and [[Notes (Rune Mysteries)|notes]] to [[Archmage Sedridor]] at two different stages of the quest. |{{Members|No}} |- |[[Enter the Abyss]] |Speak to Archmage Sedridor in the Wizards' Tower to be teleported to the Rune Essence Mine. This counts as one of the three different locations required. |{{Members|Yes}} |- |[[Temple of the Eye]] |During [[Temple of the Eye#Help from Some Wizards|Help from Some Wizards]], the player visits the Wizard's Tower to seek assistance from the wizards in understanding the mysterious eye symbol. |{{Members|Yes}} |- |[[Wanted!#Random items|Wanted!]] |During the "[[Wanted!#Chasing Solus|Chasing Solus]]" step, the player must search three of 21 possible locations—one of which may be the Wizards' Tower—in pursuit of Solus Dellagar. |{{Members|Yes}} |} ==Treasure Trails== *Killing a [[wizard]] for the [[Key (Treasure Trails)|key]] in order to search the drawers in the basement is the solution to a medium [[cryptic clue]], stating: ''[[Clue scroll (medium) - Probably filled with wizards socks|Probably filled with wizards socks.]]'' *Searching the bookcase in the basement of the tower is the solution to a hard cryptic clue, stating: ''[[Clue scroll (hard) - Probably filled with books on magic|Probably filled with books on magic.]]'' ==Personalities== *[[Archmage Sedridor]] *[[Wizard Traiborn]] *[[Wizard Mizgog]] *[[Wizard Grayzag]] *[[Wizard Jalarast]] *[[Apprentice Cordelia]] *[[Apprentice Felix]] *[[Apprentice Tamara]] *[[Rick (Wizards' Tower)|Rick]] *[[Professor Onglewip]] ==Trivia== *According to the [[rsw:DeviousMUD#The second period|map of DeviousMUD]], the forerunner to ''[[RuneScape Classic]]'', the Wizards' Tower was originally to be called "Warlocks Tower". On release, it lacked any blue Wizards for at least two weeks. This name persists in dialogue used in [[The Restless Ghost]]. *The wizards in front of the Tower appear to be wearing a [[Cape of Legends]]. *The eye on the front of the Wizards' Tower is an {{wp|Eye of Ra}}. *Before March 2006, the bridge that leads to the Wizards' Tower was not straight and had two turns. *A book on the ground floor bookshelves titled "Fire, Earth and Water ~ What's it all About?" is a reference to the {{WP|Earth, Wind & Fire}} song ''It's All About Love''. ==References== {{reflist}} {{Imp Catcher}} {{Wizards' Tower}} [[Category:Islands]] [[Category:Towers]]
